title: Four-wise polynomial sampling and universal fingerprints for twelve-orbit inversion

claims.statement: For every allowed supplied nonidentity P and nonidentity z, the full-production algorithm in proof.md returns a verified Q in G2 with pairing(Q,P)=z with success probability >0.39024 over fresh algorithm coins, under the explicitly disclosed bounded fair-coin and finite bank-window interfaces. The identity target is handled directly. Complete cold classical work including every failure, polynomial/table/seed construction, fingerprinting, sorting/lookup/transfers, arithmetic, output and verification is <=2^(632/5) target-group-operation equivalents under unchanged C=20000. Peak memory <=2^137 bytes, preprocessing <=2^120 equivalents included in total, nonuniform advice zero bytes. Four-wise and pairwise finite families replace the source's production-scale BLAKE3-output heuristic; no production execution, physical entropy certification, installed bank hardware, source qualification or promotion is claimed.

experiments.purpose: Interpret actual straight-line auxiliary assembly with 64-bit carry semantics on full-width edge and bounded reproducible vectors; compare exact modular results and preserved registers; check exact public-parameter success/cost certificates and tiny-field independence. Does not execute a production inversion or certify entropy/storage hardware.
